description: Defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_Xml for converting configuration schema interchange objects into XML format, including methods for building XML documents, namespaces, and directives, with HTML purification.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_Builder_Xml
classes.description: A class extending XMLWriter to generate XML documentation from configuration schema interchange objects.

methods.name: writeHTMLDiv
methods.description: Purifies HTML content and writes it inside a div element with XHTML namespace.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports a variable as a string, returning 'array()' for empty arrays.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the entire XML document from an interchange object, including namespaces.

methods.name: buildNamespace
methods.description: Builds XML for a namespace, including its description and directives.

methods.name: buildDirective
methods.description: Builds XML for a directive, including its attributes, constraints, and description.
